name: American Pool 3D
releaseNotes: v1.6.0 adds an opt-in CHEAT full-shot preview that runs the same fixed-tick physics solver as the actual launch, including current power. POWER is now adjusted independently by a second-finger vertical drag, so a cue against a cushion can still use full strength.
description: American Pool 3D is an original landscape 8-ball pool game with touch cue control, realistic ball-contact previews, pull-back shot power, sampled pool effects, 8-ball rules, and a computer opponent.
